entries.name: PostgreSQL

license.evidence: Official PostgreSQL distribution and Docker Official Image

entries.scope: Development database plus Stage 2 asset metadata and Stage 3 transformation/evidence persistence
entries.security: Local credentials only; production secrets remain outside source control
entries.maintenance: Major version 16 is fixed; patch and image digest updates require a registry change
entries.boundary: Domain modules access PostgreSQL only through repository ports
entries.replacement: Replace the PostgreSQL adapter without changing module contracts
entries.recheckTrigger: PostgreSQL major upgrade or managed database migration

entries.name: Ajv JSON Schema validator
entries.scope: Strict runtime validation for versioned command, event, and query payloads
entries.security: Schemas are trusted repository artifacts; untrusted remote schemas are not loaded
entries.maintenance: Exact resolved version is checked against package-lock.json
entries.boundary: Ajv is encapsulated by packages/contracts SchemaRegistry
entries.replacement: A replacement validator must pass the same SchemaRegistry and connector tests
entries.recheckTrigger: JSON Schema draft change or validator replacement

entries.name: garrytan/gbrain
entries.scope: Minion retry, timeout, idempotency, PostgreSQL locking, Page input, and namespace patterns
entries.security: No gbrain runtime, database, or provider configuration is embedded in Shotgun
entries.maintenance: Pinned v0.42.58.0 validation baseline; upstream changes are not consumed automatically
evidence: Minion lock and timeout recovery evidence
entries.boundary: Any future reuse must sit behind Shotgun Job, Repository, or Module ports
entries.replacement: Current in-memory runtime remains removable; durable queue evaluation occurs before persistent jobs
entries.recheckTrigger: Before Stage 6 persistent Inbox, Outbox, or durable Job implementation

entries.name: lucasastorian/llmwiki
entries.scope: Text quote location, prefix/suffix disambiguation, offset regression tests, and deterministic validation patterns; watcher/reconcile remains deferred
entries.security: Ambiguous short quotes are not guessed; path-based identity, SQLite, VaultFS, MCP CRUD, and filename citation remain excluded
entries.maintenance: Pinned commit only; behavior was reimplemented behind Shotgun ports without adding the upstream runtime
evidence: Shotgun locator and adapter replacement tests
entries.boundary: Lucas-derived behavior is isolated behind PlainTextTransformerPort and EvidenceLocatorPort; SourceVersion and EvidenceSpan remain Shotgun-owned
entries.replacement: A replacement transformer or locator must pass the same Golden, SourceMap, ambiguity, and replacement tests
entries.recheckTrigger: Before HTML/XLSX extraction or directory watching

entries.name: W3C Web Annotation Data Model
entries.scope: TextPositionSelector and TextQuoteSelector semantics for exact source restoration
entries.security: Selectors are always bound to immutable SourceVersion and SHA-256; quote-only ambiguous matches are not accepted as authoritative
entries.maintenance: Recommendation date is pinned; later specifications require an explicit contract version
entries.boundary: Shotgun adds sourceVersionId, content hash, exact hash, origin, and unicode-code-point unit fields
entries.replacement: Selector serialization can change only through a versioned SourceMap and EvidenceSpan contract
entries.recheckTrigger: External annotation interoperability or selector contract v2

entries.name: JSON Pointer RFC 6901

license.evidence: RFC Editor publication and IETF Trust provisions

entries.scope: Stable addressing of DocumentIR paragraphs and sentences inside SourceMap
entries.security: Unresolvable or malformed pointers are rejected before Evidence persistence
entries.maintenance: Standards-track RFC is fixed; pointer behavior is covered by Golden tests
entries.boundary: Pointers address only a stored DocumentIR revision and never a database table or file path
entries.replacement: A replacement path syntax requires SourceMap contract v2 and migration
entries.recheckTrigger: DocumentIR structural contract v2

entries.name: ddsyasas/llm-wiki
entries.scope: Source intake form, action-centered home, presentation hierarchy, and Stage 5 review-entry hierarchy
entries.security: Backend is excluded because of SSRF and arbitrary absolute-path workspace risks
entries.maintenance: 195 tests passed and 1 external smoke test skipped at the pinned baseline
entries.boundary: Only UI patterns may consume Shotgun typed APIs; backend and storage remain excluded
entries.replacement: UI can be rebuilt from the recorded workflow without carrying upstream runtime code
entries.recheckTrigger: When the Shotgun Web UI and Source Intake screen are implemented

entries.name: Inkeep OpenKnowledge

license.evidence: GPL v3 LICENSE at the pinned commit

entries.scope: Editor mode switching, 2D graph, activity, changed-item grouping, and Burst Diff UX patterns
entries.security: No runtime embedding or code copying into the current MIT-compatible product boundary
entries.maintenance: Pinned validation baseline; license impact must be re-reviewed before any code reuse
evidence: Stage 5 activity and diff pattern mapping
entries.boundary: Canonical data, approval, and Job state remain owned by Shotgun
entries.replacement: Patterns are independently reimplemented behind Shotgun APIs
entries.recheckTrigger: Before editor or graph UI implementation or any GPL code reuse

entries.name: jsdiff

license.evidence: Installed package LICENSE, npm package metadata, and package-lock.json

entries.scope: Word-level Machine Diff for fixed Canonical Snapshot versus Claim Candidate review
entries.security: Diff runs locally on already-authorized text and does not transmit content
entries.maintenance: Exact version is locked; upgrades require Golden and review UI contract tests
entries.boundary: Only adapters/text-diff-jsdiff imports the package; Comparison uses TextDiffPort
entries.replacement: Any replacement must return the same neutral TextDiffSegment contract and pass Stage 5 tests

license.evidence: Official repository and npm package metadata

entries.replacement: Can be reconsidered behind TextDiffPort if jsdiff fails a future corpus
